examples.hanzi: 法院剥夺了他的驾驶资格。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn bōduó le tā de jiàshǐ zīgé.
examples.english: The court stripped him of his driving qualification.

examples.hanzi: 任何人都不能剥夺孩子受教育的权利。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu bù néng bōduó háizi shòu jiàoyù de quánlì.
examples.english: No one can deprive a child of the right to an education.

examples.hanzi: 他的鼻子突然出血了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bízi tūrán chūxuè le.
examples.english: His nose suddenly started bleeding.

examples.hanzi: 伤口还在出血，要赶快包扎。
examples.pinyin: Shāngkǒu hái zài chūxuè, yào gǎnkuài bāozā.
examples.english: The wound is still bleeding and needs bandaging quickly.

examples.hanzi: 我的导师是一位很和蔼的教授。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de dǎoshī shì yí wèi hěn hé'ǎi de jiàoshòu.
examples.english: My advisor is a very kind professor.

examples.hanzi: 感谢导师对我论文的指导。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè dǎoshī duì wǒ lùnwén de zhǐdǎo.
examples.english: Thanks to my advisor for guiding my thesis.

examples.hanzi: 这幅画是那位画家的杰作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shì nà wèi huàjiā de jiézuò.
examples.english: This painting is that painter's masterpiece.

examples.hanzi: 这座桥是现代建筑的杰作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo shì xiàndài jiànzhù de jiézuò.
examples.english: This bridge is a masterpiece of modern architecture.

examples.hanzi: 天空乌云密布，这是暴雨的征兆。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng wūyún mìbù, zhè shì bàoyǔ de zhēngzhào.
examples.english: The sky is full of dark clouds, a sign of heavy rain.

examples.hanzi: 他发现这种征兆之后，立刻去了医院。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāxiàn zhè zhǒng zhēngzhào zhīhòu, lìkè qù le yīyuàn.
examples.english: After noticing this warning sign, he went to the hospital right away.

examples.hanzi: 这位富翁把一半财产捐给了学校。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fùwēng bǎ yíbàn cáichǎn juān gěi le xuéxiào.
examples.english: This rich man donated half of his fortune to schools.

examples.hanzi: 他想成为富翁，所以每天拼命工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi fùwēng, suǒyǐ měi tiān pīnmìng gōngzuò.
examples.english: He wants to become a rich man, so he works hard every day.

examples.hanzi: 医生说这个病例很少见。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō zhège bìnglì hěn shǎojiàn.
examples.english: The doctor said this case is very rare.

examples.hanzi: 医院整理了去年所有的病例。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn zhěnglǐ le qùnián suǒyǒu de bìnglì.
examples.english: The hospital organized all of last year's case records.

examples.hanzi: 请把不要的文件销毁。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bú yào de wénjiàn xiāohuǐ.
examples.english: Please destroy the documents you don't need.

examples.hanzi: 他把所有的证据都销毁了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de zhèngjù dōu xiāohuǐ le.
examples.english: He destroyed all of the evidence.

examples.hanzi: 我饿了一天，现在饥饿难忍。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è le yì tiān, xiànzài jī'è nán rěn.
examples.english: I haven't eaten all day and the hunger is now unbearable.

examples.hanzi: 很多国家仍然面临饥饿问题。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō guójiā réngrán miànlín jī'è wèntí.
examples.english: Many countries still face the problem of hunger.

examples.hanzi: 这件事很要紧，你一定要记住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, nǐ yídìng yào jìzhù.
examples.english: This matter is important, so you must remember it.

examples.hanzi: 今天的会议没什么要紧的事。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de huìyì méi shénme yàojǐn de shì.
examples.english: There's nothing pressing about today's meeting.

examples.hanzi: 我家的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de yángtái cháo nán, yángguāng hěn chōngzú.
examples.english: My home's balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunlight.

examples.hanzi: 他们在阳台上喝茶聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài yángtái shàng hē chá liáotiān.
examples.english: They drink tea and chat on the balcony.

examples.hanzi: 谢谢你的心意，我很感动。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de xīnyì, wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: Thank you for your kindness; I'm very touched.

examples.hanzi: 这份礼物虽然小，但是表达了我的心意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn lǐwù suīrán xiǎo, dànshì biǎodá le wǒ de xīnyì.
examples.english: Although this gift is small, it expresses my feelings.

examples.hanzi: 那个人自称是医生，可是没人相信。
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén zìchēng shì yīshēng, kěshì méi rén xiāngxìn.
examples.english: That man claims to be a doctor, but nobody believes him.

examples.hanzi: 她自称不喜欢甜食，却天天吃蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Tā zìchēng bù xǐhuan tiánshí, què tiāntiān chī dàngāo.
examples.english: She claims not to like sweets, yet eats cake every day.

examples.hanzi: 哈罗德今天请我们吃晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Hāluódé jīntiān qǐng wǒmen chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: Harold is treating us to dinner today.

examples.hanzi: 我想把这本书送给哈罗德。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn shū sòng gěi Hāluódé.
examples.english: I want to give this book to Harold.

examples.hanzi: 他在公园里给孩子们画画。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngyuán lǐ gěi háizimen huà huà.
examples.english: He is drawing pictures for the kids in the park.

examples.hanzi: 她从五岁起就开始画画了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng wǔ suì qǐ jiù kāishǐ huàhuà le.
examples.english: She has been drawing since she was five.

examples.hanzi: 火山突然喷发了，浓烟冲上天空。
examples.pinyin: Huǒshān tūrán pēnfā le, nóngyān chōng shàng tiānkōng.
examples.english: The volcano suddenly erupted, and thick smoke shot into the sky.

examples.hanzi: 我们爬上了一座活火山。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen pá shàng le yí zuò huó huǒshān.
examples.english: We climbed a volcano that is still active.

examples.hanzi: 我的上级今天要来检查工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shàngjí jīntiān yào lái jiǎnchá gōngzuò.
examples.english: My superior is coming to check on the work today.

examples.hanzi: 下级要听从上级的安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiàjí yào tīngcóng shàngjí de ānpái.
examples.english: Subordinates should follow their superiors' arrangements.

examples.hanzi: 这条牛仔裤我穿着有点紧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo niúzǎikù wǒ chuānzhe yǒudiǎn jǐn.
examples.english: These jeans are a bit tight on me.

examples.hanzi: 牛仔裤配白衬衫很好看。
examples.pinyin: Niúzǎikù pèi bái chènshān hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: Jeans with a white shirt look nice.

examples.hanzi: 他涉嫌酒后驾车，被警察带走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shèxián jiǔ hòu jiàchē, bèi jǐngchá dàizǒu le.
examples.english: He is suspected of drunk driving and was taken away by the police.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司涉嫌偷税。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shèxián tōushuì.
examples.english: This company is suspected of tax evasion.

examples.hanzi: 那名逃犯已经被抓回来了。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng táofàn yǐjīng bèi zhuā huílái le.
examples.english: That fugitive has already been caught.

examples.hanzi: 有人看见逃犯往北边跑了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén kànjiàn táofàn wǎng běibian pǎo le.
examples.english: Someone saw the fugitive run toward the north.

examples.hanzi: 这个城市的财政收入每年都在增长。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de cáizhèng shōurù měi nián dōu zài zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: This city's fiscal revenue grows every year.

examples.hanzi: 学校的财政状况不太好。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de cáizhèng zhuàngkuàng bú tài hǎo.
examples.english: The school's financial situation is not very good.

examples.hanzi: 夏天我喜欢喝加冰块的柠檬水。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒ xǐhuan hē jiā bīngkuài de níngméngshuǐ.
examples.english: In summer I like lemonade with ice cubes.

examples.hanzi: 冰箱里的冰块已经用完了。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de bīngkuài yǐjīng yòngwán le.
examples.english: The ice cubes in the fridge are all used up.

examples.hanzi: 过了二十年，他依旧很爱她。
examples.pinyin: Guò le èrshí nián, tā yījiù hěn ài tā.
examples.english: Twenty years later, he still loves her.

examples.hanzi: 虽然下着雨，大家依旧去爬山了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiàzhe yǔ, dàjiā yījiù qù pá shān le.
examples.english: Even though it was raining, everyone still went hiking.

examples.hanzi: 他是和平的使者，到处宣传友谊。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì hépíng de shǐzhě, dàochù xuānchuán yǒuyì.
examples.english: He is a messenger of peace who promotes friendship everywhere.

examples.hanzi: 邻国派使者来参加庆典。
examples.pinyin: Línguó pài shǐzhě lái cānjiā qìngdiǎn.
examples.english: The neighboring country sent an envoy to the celebration.

examples.hanzi: 这两个城市的生活水平差别很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè chéngshì de shēnghuó shuǐpíng chābié hěn dà.
examples.english: The living standards in these two cities differ greatly.

examples.hanzi: 双胞胎之间几乎没有什么差别。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngbāotāi zhījiān jīhū méiyǒu shénme chābié.
examples.english: There is hardly any difference between the twins.

examples.hanzi: 法律禁止遗弃老人和孩子。
examples.pinyin: Fǎlǜ jìnzhǐ yíqì lǎorén hé háizi.
examples.english: The law forbids abandoning the elderly and children.

examples.hanzi: 他从不遗弃自己养的宠物。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng bù yíqì zìjǐ yǎng de chǒngwù.
examples.english: He never abandons the pets he keeps.

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服有个小缺陷，所以打折了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒu gè xiǎo quēxiàn, suǒyǐ dǎzhé le.
examples.english: This garment has a small flaw, so it's discounted.

examples.hanzi: 每个人都有自己的缺陷。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de quēxiàn.
examples.english: Everyone has their own shortcomings.

examples.hanzi: 炮兵的火力压住了对方的进攻。
examples.pinyin: Pàobīng de huǒlì yāzhù le duìfāng de jìngōng.
examples.english: The artillery's firepower held back the enemy's attack.

examples.hanzi: 灶上的火力太大，菜都煮糊了。
examples.pinyin: Zào shàng de huǒlì tài dà, cài dōu zhǔ hú le.
examples.english: The heat on the stove was too high, and the dish got burnt.

examples.hanzi: 上个月我换了一份新工作。
examples.pinyin: Shàng gè yuè wǒ huàn le yí fèn xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Last month I changed to a new job.

examples.hanzi: 这家店上个月刚开业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn shàng gè yuè gāng kāiyè.
examples.english: This shop only opened last month.

examples.hanzi: 火腿和鸡蛋是很常见的早餐。
examples.pinyin: Huǒtuǐ hé jīdàn shì hěn chángjiàn de zǎocān.
examples.english: Ham and eggs are a very common breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 这块火腿太咸了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài huǒtuǐ tài xián le.
examples.english: This piece of ham is too salty.

examples.hanzi: 老师立刻制止了他们的吵闹。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī lìkè zhìzhǐ le tāmen de chǎonào.
examples.english: The teacher immediately put a stop to their noise.

examples.hanzi: 我们要制止浪费粮食的行为。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhìzhǐ làngfèi liángshi de xíngwéi.
examples.english: We should stop the wasting of food.

examples.hanzi: 他想找一份安定的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo yí fèn āndìng de gōngzuò.
examples.english: He wants to find a stable job.

examples.hanzi: 搬到新家后，孩子的情绪渐渐安定下来。
examples.pinyin: Bān dào xīn jiā hòu, háizi de qíngxù jiànjiàn āndìng xiàlái.
examples.english: After moving to the new home, the child gradually calmed down.

examples.hanzi: 别用“贱货”这种脏话骂人。
examples.pinyin: Bié yòng "jiànhuò" zhè zhǒng zānghuà mà rén.
examples.english: Don't curse at people with a foul word like "jiànhuò".

examples.hanzi: 这个词是一句很难听的骂人话，“贱货”。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí shì yí jù hěn nántīng de mà rén huà, "jiànhuò".
examples.english: This is a very ugly insult: "jiànhuò".

examples.hanzi: 门锁坏了，我打不开门。
examples.pinyin: Ménsuǒ huài le, wǒ dǎ bù kāi mén.
examples.english: The door lock is broken and I can't open the door.

examples.hanzi: 出门前记得检查一下门锁。
examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián jìde jiǎnchá yíxià ménsuǒ.
examples.english: Remember to check the door lock before leaving.

examples.hanzi: 这个小伙干活很勤快。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎohuǒ gànhuó hěn qínkuai.
examples.english: This young guy works very diligently.

examples.hanzi: 几个小伙在球场上打篮球。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ gè xiǎohuǒ zài qiúchǎng shàng dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: A few young guys are playing basketball on the court.

examples.hanzi: 这场球赛真是好戏连台。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng qiúsài zhēn shì hǎoxì liántái.
examples.english: This match was a great show from start to finish.

examples.hanzi: 大家都在等着看好戏。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zài děngzhe kàn hǎoxì.
examples.english: Everyone is waiting to see the fun unfold.

examples.hanzi: 他的后背靠在椅子上。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hòubèi kào zài yǐzi shàng.
examples.english: His back leaned against the chair.

examples.hanzi: 妈妈轻轻拍着宝宝的后背。
examples.pinyin: Māma qīngqīng pāizhe bǎobao de hòubèi.
examples.english: Mom gently pats the baby on the back.

examples.hanzi: 你的身高有多少？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngāo yǒu duōshao?
examples.english: How tall are you?

examples.hanzi: 孩子的身高一年比一年高。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de shēngāo yì nián bǐ yì nián gāo.
examples.english: The child grows taller every year.

examples.hanzi: 这位老太太每天早上都打太极拳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎotàitai měi tiān zǎoshang dōu dǎ tàijíquán.
examples.english: This old lady does tai chi every morning.

examples.hanzi: 我扶着老太太过了马路。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fúzhe lǎotàitai guò le mǎlù.
examples.english: I helped the old lady cross the street.

examples.hanzi: 家属已经把赎金交给了绑匪。
examples.pinyin: Jiāshǔ yǐjīng bǎ shújīn jiāo gěi le bǎngfěi.
examples.english: The family has already handed the ransom to the kidnappers.

examples.hanzi: 电影里的海盗要求一大笔赎金。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de hǎidào yāoqiú yí dà bǐ shújīn.
examples.english: The pirates in the movie demand a large ransom.

examples.hanzi: 孩子哭个不停，让妈妈很心烦。
examples.pinyin: Háizi kū gè bù tíng, ràng māma hěn xīnfán.
examples.english: The child won't stop crying, which makes Mom upset.

examples.hanzi: 别来烦我，我现在心烦着呢。
examples.pinyin: Bié lái fán wǒ, wǒ xiànzài xīnfán zhe ne.
examples.english: Don't bother me; I'm feeling irritated right now.

examples.hanzi: 网上的言论不一定都是真的。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshàng de yánlùn bù yídìng dōu shì zhēn de.
examples.english: Opinions online are not necessarily all true.

examples.hanzi: 他发表了一些不当言论，受到了批评。
examples.pinyin: Tā fābiǎo le yìxiē búdàng yánlùn, shòudào le pīpíng.
examples.english: He made some inappropriate remarks and was criticized.

examples.hanzi: 谁让你不听劝，活该！
examples.pinyin: Shéi ràng nǐ bù tīng quàn, huógāi!
examples.english: Serves you right for not listening to advice!

examples.hanzi: 他迟到被老板批评，真是活该。
examples.pinyin: Tā chídào bèi lǎobǎn pīpíng, zhēnshi huógāi.
examples.english: He was late and got scolded by the boss; he deserved it.

examples.hanzi: 申请工作要先写一份简历。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng gōngzuò yào xiān xiě yí fèn jiǎnlì.
examples.english: To apply for a job you first need to write a résumé.

examples.hanzi: 请把你的简历发到我的邮箱。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de jiǎnlì fā dào wǒ de yóuxiāng.
examples.english: Please send your résumé to my email.

examples.hanzi: 这家小店每个月的利润不多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn měi gè yuè de lìrùn bù duō.
examples.english: This little shop doesn't make much profit each month.

examples.hanzi: 他们靠卖水果赚取利润。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen kào mài shuǐguǒ zhuànqǔ lìrùn.
examples.english: They make a profit by selling fruit.

examples.hanzi: 他的回答既简短又恰当。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huídá jì jiǎnduǎn yòu qiàdàng.
examples.english: His answer was both brief and appropriate.

examples.hanzi: 在这种场合穿牛仔裤不太恰当。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng chǎnghé chuān niúzǎikù bú tài qiàdàng.
examples.english: Wearing jeans on this kind of occasion is not quite appropriate.

examples.hanzi: 我拨打了三次，他都没接电话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bōdǎ le sān cì, tā dōu méi jiē diànhuà.
examples.english: I dialed three times, and he didn't pick up.

examples.hanzi: 请拨打客服热线咨询。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bōdǎ kèfú rèxiàn zīxún.
examples.english: Please call the customer service hotline for inquiries.

examples.hanzi: 他的身体哪个部位疼？
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ nǎge bùwèi téng?
examples.english: Which part of his body hurts?

examples.hanzi: 车的这个部位容易生锈。
examples.pinyin: Chē de zhège bùwèi róngyì shēngxiù.
examples.english: This part of the car rusts easily.

examples.hanzi: 隔壁传来了一阵吵闹声。
examples.pinyin: Gébì chuánlái le yí zhèn chǎonào shēng.
examples.english: A burst of noisy sound came from next door.

examples.hanzi: 这个好消息很快就传来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hǎo xiāoxi hěn kuài jiù chuánlái le.
examples.english: This good news arrived very quickly.

examples.hanzi: 罗斯是我大学时的好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Luósī shì wǒ dàxué shí de hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: Ross was a good friend of mine in college.

examples.hanzi: 今天罗斯要给我们讲一个故事。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Luósī yào gěi wǒmen jiǎng yí gè gùshi.
examples.english: Today Ross is going to tell us a story.
